title: The Rebel's Silhouette: Selected Poems by Faiz Ahmed Faiz

verification.verification_notes: Author, translator, title, publisher, and ISBN verified via University of Massachusetts Press. Publication year 1991 per the translator's and publisher's records (a 1992 date appears in some Poetry Foundation pages; the 1995 paperback is separately listed). The translator's stated choice of free verse and the loss of the original's rhyme/sound verified via the publisher description and a Poetry Foundation commentary on Ali's translations.

limitations: Rhyme and quantitative metre of the Urdu original are not carried into the English free-verse translations, so the sound-borne grief register is only partly available to an English reader.
